title: Your Body Is Weak Because Your Mind Gave Up First

scenes.text: Look at yourself. Tired all the time. Can't sleep. Out of breath on the stairs.
You think your body is failing you. It's not. Your mind gave up first, and your body just followed orders.
Here's the good news. It works the other way too. Move your body, and your mind starts to follow.
You don't need a gym. You don't need the perfect program.
Get on the floor right now and do ten push-ups. Can't do ten? Do three. Tomorrow, do four.
Walk twenty minutes a day. Sleep at the same time every night. Cut the junk that keeps you numb.
Strength comes back faster than you think. Every rep, every walk, every early night is proof you're not finished.
A strong body builds a strong mind. And a strong mind never stays down. Start today.
